final: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM per_account), kept AS (SELECT p.account_id, p.order_count, o.avg_count FROM per_account p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.order_count > o.avg_count), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.order_count - k.avg_count AS above_average_by, k.order_count - ka.avg_count AS above_kept_average_by FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_average ka ORDER BY above_kept_average_by DESC LIMIT 10
